prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision in which our client's vehicle was struck from behind. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of all policies that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, recorded statements, telematics and event data, claim file notes, adjuster reports, and any dash camera or surveillance footage in your possession or control. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
